wave_5_terminal_child.title: Run FER simulation over AWGN for full DVB-T2 FEC chain

campaign.host: AMD Ryzen 9 5900X + AMD Radeon RX 6950 XT (gfx1030), seed 42
campaign.waterfall: sharp cliff (~1 decade FER per 0.045 dB); FER=1e-4 crossing ~0.15 dB above the regression FER-at-anchor. r1/2 16qam measured crossing ~6.145 dB vs ETSI 6.0 anchor => gap ~0.15 dB.
campaign.gap_risk: 64-QAM configs (1/2, 2/3, 3/4) have FER-at-anchor 0.31-0.65 and may land near/over the 0.5 dB gap criterion; measure first, escalate per policy if any curve exceeds 0.5 dB.

escalations.resolution: Session 1: lead delivers calibration, user runs prod. Session 2: user directs lead to run full production on GPU to completion.

escalations.cause: ETSI TS 102 831 Table 44 anchors use Genie-Aided demapping; spec (S14.2, above Table 44) states this is optimistic for high-order constellations. Our in-scope single-pass ExactLogMap BICM is below the genie bound. 16-QAM passes (0.12-0.23 dB), 64-QAM does not, exactly as spec predicts.
escalations.resolution: User APPROVED 'Amend with spec rationale' (2026-06-13): keep <=0.5 dB for 16-QAM, set data-backed 64-QAM target citing genie-aided spec text, record observed numbers. Then close.
